purpose: Classify and route questions about bringing land into the registered title system without treating an application route as proof that registration will be granted.

routes.condition: Unregistered property with a qualifying title and applicable first-registration route
A transaction or statutory circumstance triggers compulsory registration
Applicant relies on possession rather than documentary title
Registration status or title basis cannot be established

evidence_requirements: historical documents where historical title matters
legal_distinctions: First registration is a registration procedure, not automatic proof that the applicant has good title.
Possessory title is distinct from documentary title and has its own statutory and procedural requirements.
Compulsory registration is distinct from voluntary first registration.
Registration outcome and underlying title merits are separate questions.
guardrails: Never infer registration status without evidence.
Never convert possession alone into ownership.
Never use a current form as proof of historical legal requirements without date checking.
